archive_cost_boundary.compression_feasibility: The 512-MiB cap is a stop condition, not a claim that compression will fit; no alternative precision or block strategy is tried.

archive_verification.scope: all block file hashes and all uncompressed array hashes/shape/dtype; no mathematical residual certificate

array_memory.note: Measured persistent array sizes, excluding transient RK/FFT/compression allocations; peak process RSS is checked separately.

budget_monitoring: wall alarm plus elapsed/peak-RSS checks after each step, node, FFT group and archive write, with a post-final-write success gate. Exceeding any observed cap cannot succeed; this does not claim OS prevention of transient allocation overruns.

checkout.scope: checkout reference only; no clean-tree claim; actual source bytes are separately hashed

config.G: lexicographic integer triples k in [-8,8]^3, excluding (0,0,0)
config.node_reference: c_k=P_k[(Z_k+conj(Z_-k))/(2*2^52)]; slopes use their own integer array by the identical formula
config.projection: P_k=I-k tensor k/|k|^2 over the rationals; zero mode and outside G are exactly zero
config.reference_between_nodes: C1_RESIDUAL_CONTRACT V.4: shared-node cubic Hermite, physical time h=1/2048
config.rounding: numpy.rint: nearest integer, ties to even, separately on real/imaginary binary64 components
config.slopes: one separate SpectralSystem.rhs(state) evaluation per node; no RK stage reused

limitations: Successful production is neither an NS trajectory certificate nor global regularity or singularity.
The rational shared-node reference is determined uniquely by archived integers, conjugate averaging and exact P_k.
Q52 nearest-even conversion is quantization, not lossless compression of the unstored floating-point RK stages.
Floating diagnostics evaluate that integer reference approximately; sampled M_j are not spatial supremum bounds.
Nine node residual observations do not certify time-continuous Hermite residuals or infinite-dimensional errors.
A small approximate endpoint A_-1 does not pay the full residual/control contract.
